[Intro]
[Am]

[Verse 1]
[Am]The fairer sex,
they often call [C/E]it
[F]But her love's as unfair
as a crook It
[F#dim]steals all my reason Com-
mits every treason Of
[Gsus4]logic, with naught but a
[E7/G#]look

[Verse 2]
[Am]A storm raging
on the [C/E]horizon
[F]Of a longing and hear-
tache and lust She's
[F#dim]always bad news It's
always lose, lose So
[Gsus4]tell me love, tell me love
[E7/G#]How is that just?

[Chorus]
[F]But the story is this
[F#dim]She'll destroy with her sweet
[Am]kiss Her sweet
kiss
[F]But the story is this
[F#dim]She'll destroy with her sweet
[Am]kiss

[Verse 3]
[Am]Her current is
pulling you [C/E]closer
[F]And charging the hot,
humid night The
[F#dim]red sky at dawn is
giving a warning, you fool
[Gsus4]Better stay out of
[E7/G#]sight

[Verse 4]
[Am]I'm weak my love,
and I am [C/E]wanting
[F]If this is the path
I must trudge I
[F#dim]welcome my sentence Give
to you my penance Gar-
[Gsus4]rotter, jury and
[E7/G#]judge
